decision.summary: No confirmed temporary offset intervals: both candidate windows (490–549 and 550–600) show coherent but unidirectional or sustained motion without an opposing return within the allowed context [455,699]. U-component remains noisy and uncoupled; no evidence of a closed transient on any axis.

intervals.observation: E rises monotonically from ~490 to 549; N declines steadily over same span. No opposing return observed within allowed context; motion continues beyond 549 without reversal.

E plateaus ~550–600; N also stabilizes (less steep decline) during same window. However, neither axis shows a clear opposing return after 600—N resumes decline, E resumes rise after 600. No confirmed closure of offset.
